working:
Inputs: Census I (Official_Population_Census.md line 506, matches Davis.md line 15) gives H=590,668 and R=619,764, so residents=1,210,432. D=1.25 and f=1.00 (GROWER) are confirmed in file 16 section 19 and the Half B row (line 262).

Python (Decimal) arithmetic:
- workforce = 619,764 + 0.5 x 590,668 = 619,764 + 295,334 = 915,098.
- baseline = H x (120.7 x 1.00 x 1.25 + 85.6)/1000 + residents x (64 x 1.25 + 113.2)/1000 + R x 15.75/1000.
  - Human-keyed term: 590,668 x 0.236475 = 139,678.2153.
  - Resident-keyed term: 1,210,432 x 0.1932 = 233,855.4624.
  - Robot-keyed term: 619,764 x 0.01575 = 9,761.283.
  - Sum = 383,294.9607, which rounds half up to 383,295. This matches the section 19 table.
- distinctive = 915,098 - 383,295 = 531,803.
- mandated = 531,803 x (0.35 + 0.125) = 531,803 x 0.475 = 252,606.425, which rounds to 252,606. The sub-parts are agriculture 186,131 and half of technical/scientific 66,475 (66,475.375 before rounding, 186,131 + 66,475 = 252,606). This matches the section 19 mandate table.
- free = 531,803 - 252,606 = 279,197.
- Shares of the 915,098 workforce, 1 decimal: baseline 383,295 = 41.9%, mandated 252,606 = 27.6%, free 279,197 = 30.5%. They sum to 100.0%.

working: Only the sign of "difference" differed between rounds. Counter B reported -134,153 because it took distinctive-based minus workforce-based. The magnitude agrees across all counters. I recomputed in python3 from Census I line 506 (H=590,668, R=619,764, N=1,210,432). Davis is a grower, so f=1.00, and D=1.25 (file 16 line 262). Workforce = R + 0.5H = 619,764 + 295,334 = 915,098, which matches file 16 line 262. Baseline = H*(120.7*1.25+85.6)/1000 + N*(64*1.25+113.2)/1000 + R*15.75/1000 = 383,294.9607, which rounds to 383,295. Distinctive = 915,098 - 383,294.9607 = 531,803.0393, which rounds to 531,803. Agriculture 35% of distinctive = 186,131.06, which rounds to 186,131. 35% of whole workforce = 320,284.3, which rounds to 320,284. Difference = workforce-based minus distinctive-based = 320,284 - 186,131 = 134,153. The unrounded difference is 134,153.236, which also rounds to 134,153, so rounding order does not matter. I report the difference as a positive magnitude, 134,153. This is how much larger the whole-workforce figure is than the distinctive-tier figure, and it is the usual reading of "difference". If the reader wants it signed as distinctive-based minus workforce-based, it is -134,153. There is no arithmetic dispute.
